name: Nanyo (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Nanyo city emblem in white: two joined loops with a pointed top, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Nanyo, a city in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 July 1967.

features.role: Nanyo city emblem — two joined loops with a pointed top, like a stylised character
